I recently read Fight Club - top shit. Is invisible monsters remix as good? And how does a book remix work? Like CP wrote his own rendition of another book or something? Please explain, sounds cool.

He originally intended for the book to be out of order. Think like a choose your own adventure book, but with no decisions. Just "now go to page 149", with the intent being that you'll never know when the climax is coming which you invariably do when you're reading a book with normal ordering. It adds a charm, especially in a book that is so filled with outrageousness.

His publishers at the time pretty much told him he was a nobody and there is no way an untested author is going to get an unconventional book like that published. That is no longer the case.
Ah I see, thanks for the explanation. That sounds like something he would do.. So is the remix the original, or the chronological edition?
The as-originally-intended, out of order by page but but not in chronology. Its only to confuse your sense of progress in the book.
